idea.text: Nvidia will beat earning next quarter

reading.summary: The library's judgements offer mixed support for an earnings beat: revenue and expense-growth views are bearish, while segment revenue is bullish and several other drivers are neutral. Data-center revenue is judged neutral, and AI-capex estimates describe a substantial spending backdrop without directly judging its support for Nvidia demand. No view directly covers whether Nvidia beats earnings expectations in the next fiscal quarter.

parts.query: Nvidia data center revenue growth next quarter and contribution to earnings
parts.why: The FY2027 data-center revenue view is directly relevant but judged neutral; related revenue and chip-demand views are mixed, while operating-expense growth is judged bearish.
